meta.name: Monster of the Week
meta.notes: Seat limits are decision D3 (3.16). Rules: the first draft (Appendix G) as amended in section 3. Cards: the core deck, the 21 cards here. Numbers: first-draft guesses (G.7), each a variant. Map: the prototype board, layout D (testing only).

slayerGroups.name: AV Club
slayerGroups.trope: Teen hackers and computer club nerds

slayerGroups.name: Father and the Flock
slayerGroups.trope: A parish exorcist and reluctant helpers

cards.name: Invite Them In
cards.text: Two groups of different factions next door are invited into an empty location. Target: where they’re invited.

readings.location: an empty Nocturnal location; any two groups next to it.
readings.faction: a location held by a lone group of another faction, next to a Nocturnal group: only the Nocturnals come.

layout.gist: groups next door into one location
loc: any two groups next to it, of different factions
fac: a location held by a lone group of another faction, next to a Nocturnal group
layout.flavour: Leave the door open and the porch light on. Something always comes in.

cards.name: The Gate
cards.text: Join two locations for the rest of the round: they count as a single location for movement, and fight as one (strength and sway added across both; a true tie scorches both). Never three factions across them. Only 1 sway, at one end: from the Sci-Fi faction if it is at either end, otherwise a faction there. Target: the two ends.

readings.faction: two locations holding the Sci-Fi faction.

layout.gist: two locations, for the rest of the round
specifics: They count as a single location for movement.
They fight as one: strength and sway added across both; a true tie scorches both.
Never three factions across them.
Only 1 sway, at one end: from the Sci-Fi faction if it is at either end, otherwise a faction there.
layout.flavour: There's a rift behind the arcade. Whatever goes in comes out somewhere else.

cards.name: Spoof the Signal
cards.text: A spoofed command signal: engage the strongest hostile force in range, it marches on the largest lone group of another faction within two locations of it (ties: your choice). Target: the group fooled.

readings.location: a group at a Sentient location.

layout.gist: the largest lone group of another faction within two locations
specifics: Ties: your choice.
layout.flavour: A spoofed command signal: engage the strongest hostile force in range.

cards.name: Bait the Herd
cards.text: Lay a trail of bait: a group follows it from neighbour to neighbour, picking up its own kind at every stop and leaving nothing behind. It stops where you choose, or crashes into a lone group of another faction. Target: the herd.

readings.location: a group at an Undead location.

layout.gist: a group, from neighbour to neighbour
specifics: It picks up its own kind at every stop and leaves nothing behind.
It stops where you choose, or crashes into a lone group of another faction.
layout.flavour: Lay a trail of bait, and the herd follows it.

cards.name: Perform the Ritual
cards.text: The rite begins, and one faction next door is drawn to it: every group of it comes, whole if it’s alone, as many as you choose if it’s in a fight. The centre is empty or holds one faction. Target: the centre, then the faction called.

readings.location: a Demon location; any faction is called.
readings.faction: any location next to the Demon faction; the Demons are called.

layout.gist: one faction next door, every group of it, into the centre
layout.target: the centre, then the faction called
fac: any location next to the Demon faction
specifics: Whole if it’s alone; as many as you choose if it’s in a fight.
The centre is empty or holds one faction.
layout.flavour: The rite begins, and one faction next door is drawn to it.

cards.name: Draw Them Away
cards.text: Distractions are set all round, and one of the dead shambles off to check each. A group sends 1 token to each of at least two neighbours; the rest stay. Target: the group.

readings.location: a group at an Undead location.

layout.gist: 1 token to each of at least two neighbours
specifics: The rest stay.
layout.flavour: Distractions are set all round, and one of the dead shambles off to check each.

cards.name: The Big Chase
cards.text: Lead them on a chase across town from neighbour to neighbour, across any region, through empty ground, lone rivals, its own kind and fights it’s part of. Every location it passes keeps 1 token; the rest, at least 1, arrive wherever you end it. Target: the group chased.

readings.location: a group at a Sci-Fi location.

layout.gist: a group from neighbour to neighbour; every location it passes keeps 1
specifics: Across any region, through empty ground, lone rivals, its own kind and fights it’s part of.
The rest, at least 1, arrive wherever you end it.
layout.flavour: Lead them on a chase across town.

cards.name: Cut the Powerlines
cards.text: Cut the powerlines, and the town goes dark. A group scatters to its faction’s other groups anywhere on the island, 1 token at a time: no group gets a second until every group has one. A lone group leaves entirely; from a fight, exactly half. Target: the group.

readings.location: any group at a Sentient location.

layout.gist: a group to its faction’s other groups anywhere, 1 token at a time
specifics: No group gets a second until every group has one.
A lone group leaves entirely; from a fight, exactly half.
layout.flavour: Cut the powerlines, and the town goes dark.

cards.name: Plough Through
cards.text: A truck straight through the middle of the brawl. Every side leaves by half, rounded up, split as you choose among its neighbours, never two sides to the same location. Its sway is paid by the factions in the fight or the Nocturnals, split as you choose. Target: the fight.

readings.location: a fight at a Nocturnal location.
readings.faction: a fight the Nocturnals are in.

layout.gist: every side of a fight, by half, rounded up
specifics: Split as you choose among its neighbours, never two sides to the same location.
Its sway is paid by the factions in the fight or the Nocturnals, split as you choose.
layout.flavour: A truck straight through the middle of the brawl.

cards.name: Light of the Cross
cards.text: The cross is raised and the target group falls back from its light, split evenly between two neighbours. A group of 1 can’t be split. Target: the group.

readings.location: any group at a Demon location.

layout.gist: a group, evenly between two neighbours
specifics: A group of 1 can’t be split.
layout.flavour: The cross is raised and the target group falls back from its light.

cards.name: Wake the Dead
cards.text: The fight spills into the old cemetery, and the dead rise: as many from the Undead supply as you choose, up to the card’s sway. At an Undead location they rise as a group of their own, and if two factions are already fighting there, as a third side. Each one risen places 1 of your sway there. Target: where they rise.

readings.location: any Undead location; at a fight there, the dead rise as a third side.
readings.faction: any location holding the Undead; the risen join them.

layout.gist: as many as you choose from the Undead supply, up to the card’s sway
loc: as a group of their own; at a fight there, as a third side
specifics: Each one risen places 1 of your sway there.
layout.flavour: The fight spills into the old cemetery, and the dead rise.

cards.name: Take Control
cards.text: Take control of the machines and turn them on the enemy. At the target fight, spend your sway there, 1 for each, to cut down up to the card’s sway of a faction’s tokens there: you take them as trophies, and the sway spent goes back to your supply. Target: the fight, then the faction hit.

readings.location: any fight at a Sentient location; you choose the faction hit.
readings.faction: any fight the Sentients are in; their rival is hit.

layout.gist: up to the card’s sway of a faction’s tokens at a fight, as trophies
layout.target: the fight, then the faction hit
loc: any fight at a Sentient location
fac: any fight the Sentients are in
specifics: Spend your sway there, 1 for each.
The sway spent goes back to your supply.
layout.flavour: Take control of the machines and turn them on the enemy.

cards.name: Night Terrors
cards.text: Terrors stir in the dark. Mark up to the card’s sway of locations, 1 sway on each. When night falls, before the fights, at each mark you may make 1 token of a faction there flee to a neighbouring location it can enter; your sway from the mark may follow it. Target: the locations marked.

layout.gist: up to the card’s sway of locations, 1 sway on each
specifics: When night falls, before the fights, at each mark you may make 1 token of a faction there flee to a neighbouring location it can enter.
Your sway from the mark may follow it.
layout.flavour: Terrors stir in the dark.

cards.name: Study the Bodies
cards.text: Sneak in after the fight to study the bodies. Mark up to the card’s sway of locations, 1 sway on each. This round, at a marked location’s fight, if you have first claim there, you also take 1 trophy from the second claim’s pile. Target: the locations marked.

layout.gist: up to the card’s sway of locations, 1 sway on each
specifics: This round, at a marked location’s fight, if you have first claim there, you also take 1 trophy from the second claim’s pile.
layout.flavour: Sneak in after the fight to study the bodies.

cards.name: Spill Blood on the Altar
cards.text: Blood is spilled on the altar. Mark up to the card’s sway of locations, 1 sway on each. This round, at a marked location’s fight, the winner loses as many as the loser. Target: the locations marked.

layout.gist: up to the card’s sway of locations, 1 sway on each
specifics: This round, at a marked location’s fight, the winner loses as many as the loser.
layout.flavour: Blood is spilled on the altar.

cards.name: Call in Favours
cards.text: Choose one. Sway: 1 sway from your supply at each of up to X fights. Standing: up to X standing with one faction, from your supply. X is the cards in your hand, this one included.

up to X standing with one faction, from your supply.

specifics: X is the cards in your hand, this one included.
layout.flavour: Everyone in this town owes somebody something. Tonight you collect.

cards.name: Raise the Stakes
cards.text: Choose one. Standing: take 1 standing from each of up to X factions, all into one. Sway: gather up to X of your sway from next door into one location. Tokens: up to X tokens of one faction come in from its groups next door, to a location where you have sway. X is the cards in your hand, this one included.

cards.name: Cover Every Exit
cards.text: Choose one. Standing: move 1 standing from one faction to each of up to X others. Sway: send 1 of your sway from one location to each of up to X neighbours. Tokens: a group sends 1 token to each of up to X neighbours. X is the cards in your hand, this one included.

cards.name: Showdown
cards.text: At a lone group, never a fight, burn your sway there, 1 for each token, to take that many of its tokens as your trophies. Burned sway goes back to your supply. Target: the group.

layout.gist: a lone group’s tokens, 1 of your sway burned for each
specifics: Never a fight.
You take them as your trophies.
Burned sway goes back to your supply.

cards.name: Switch Allegiance
cards.text: Choose one. Standing: burn up to X standing with one faction to gain the same with another. Sway: move up to X of your sway from one location to any other. X is the cards in your hand, this one included.

move up to X of your sway from one location to any other.

specifics: X is the cards in your hand, this one included.

cards.name: Steal Their Playbook
cards.text: Take any card played earlier this round, by anyone, however it was played, from the played cards into your hand, to play later, and you go first next round. It can't be your last card played: as the last card in your hand it is discarded, for no effect.

uses.text: any card played earlier this round, by anyone, however it was played; it's yours to play later.

specifics: You go first next round.
It can’t be your last card played: as the last card in your hand it is discarded, for no effect.
layout.flavour: Whatever worked for them will work twice as well for us.

variants.label: Rounds
variants.description: Fixed game length (GL1): 5 rounds (D49).

variants.label: Rounds as votes
variants.description: Rounds as votes (D51): each round's close, after the fights, is a vote, for the invaders if total presence is more than the threshold, else for the island; the side with more votes wins. On by default; early ends the game once a side holds a majority; off is the single count after the last round, kept to test.

variants.label: First round's vote
variants.description: Designer's seed (2026-11-05; testing): with rounds as votes, the first round's vote counts this many. 0 with lastVote 2: five votes (rounds 2-4 one each, round 5 two), no ties.

variants.label: Last round's vote
variants.description: Designer's seed (2026-11-01; testing): with rounds as votes, the last round's vote counts this many. 2: six votes; the invaders need strictly more, so 3–3 goes to the island (designer). 3: seven votes, no ties.

variants.label: Monsters grow after the last round
variants.description: D41 (designer, 2026-10-31): the last round's monsters don't grow: the game ends after its fights, with no nightfall tokens or growth. On restores them.

variants.label: Presence threshold per player
variants.description: Testing (off by default): the threshold is this many per player (10 a player: 30 at 3, 40 at 4, 50 at 5), in place of the fixed threshold (D42). Off uses the fixed threshold.

variants.label: Presence threshold
variants.description: The invaders win if total presence at the end is more than this (TH1): 20 at every player count (D42).

variants.label: Tokens per faction
variants.description: Each faction's tokens, board and supply together: unlimited by default, a supply never runs out (D46); the numbers kept to test.

variants.label: Cubes per player
variants.description: Each player's sway cubes: 30, a bump from 20 so the supply rarely limits play (D49); the balancing number comes later.

variants.label: Starting sway
variants.description: Standing each slayer group starts with, with its own faction: 5 (D49).

variants.label: Starting standing with other factions
variants.description: Standing each player starts with, with every faction other than their own: 2 (D43), so more strikes and shifts can be paid for in round 1.

variants.label: Starting sway on affinity locations
variants.description: Designer (2026-10-07; 2 since D47, 2026-11-04): each slayer group starts with 2 sway on the board at each of its affinity locations (its archetype’s three), from its supply.

variants.label: Slayer groups
variants.description: How slayer groups are given out: at random (D49).

choices.label: Random
choices.description: Each seat draws a slayer group at random.

choices.label: Seat order
choices.description: Seats take slayer groups in spec order.

variants.label: Sway per move
variants.description: Test lever (sway economy, 2026-10-07): sway a move places at each destination, from standing with the faction moved (CA2).

choices.description: The first draft.
Test lever.

variants.label: A way back for factions
variants.description: Designer (2026-10-26), first draft: a suit card may be played to bring its faction back while it has no location with 2 or more of its tokens: up to the card's sway of its tokens at its suit locations or where it is, 1 standing with it each.

choices.label: On
choices.description: The first draft.

choices.label: Off
choices.description: No way back: a faction wiped out stays gone.

variants.label: Starting tokens
variants.description: How each faction's tokens start on its three aligned locations (SD1): 2 on each (D33); 3 on each (even) and 5, 1 and 1 (home) kept to test.

choices.label: 5, 1 and 1
choices.description: SD1 as first drafted: 5 on a random home location, 1 on each of the other two.

choices.label: 3 on each
choices.description: The first draft (designer, 2026-10-17): 3 on each of the three (45 in all).

choices.label: 2 on each
choices.description: SD1 (designer, 2026-10-21): 2 on each of the three (30 in all).
Designer's seed (2026-11-02; testing): 5 on one of the three, 2 on each of the others (45 in all).

variants.label: Passing
variants.description: Designer (2026-10-28): a switch, not a decision; off by default (passing looked like a lazy way to wait for others). With passing off there is no passing: on your turn you play a card (for its action, for sway, or for no effect when it has nothing to target), the hard choice instead of waiting; a player whose hand is empty is skipped, and the round's play ends when every card has been played.

choices.label: On
choices.description: The first draft (TU1): play or pass; passing is not final.

choices.label: Off
choices.description: No passing: play a card each turn; the round ends when every card is played.

variants.label: Extra card sway
variants.description: Designer (2026-10-29): bump up sway values, to make more card actions payable (the game feel tuning, 1.7). Added to every suited card's sway: a strike's and shift's printed sway, and a signature's hand size (designer, 2026-11-01: signatures get it too); unsuited cards have none. The amount is being measured. Designer (2026-10-29): stays as a switch at +0.

choices.description: The printed sway.
Strikes 3, shifts 4.
Strikes 4, shifts 5.

variants.label: Light of the Cross
variants.description: The designer's new draft of the Demons shift (design document H.0, 2026-11-08; a draft, not a decision), off by default while it is measured. Plant the cross on a group (principle 14: location reading, any group at a Demon location; faction reading, a Demon group anywhere); its reach is that location and its neighbours. Every group of that faction in reach is driven out to a location of its own just outside the reach, the planted one first (from a fight, half); 1 sway a group, from standing with the faction, where it left or where it lands; every group you can pay for and land must go. The rest hide: no card moves them until nightfall. Until nightfall no card moves that faction into the reach.

choices.label: Split
choices.description: The card as dealt: the target group split evenly between two neighbours.

choices.label: Plant the cross
choices.description: The new draft (H.0).

variants.label: Draw Them Away
variants.description: Go Loud, the designer's new draft of the Undead shift (design document H.0, 2026-11-08; a draft, not a decision), off by default while it is measured. By principle 14 the target is any group at an Undead location, or an Undead group anywhere. Choose locations within 2 steps of it where you have sway, as many as you choose, and place 1 more sway at each (from standing with the faction moved). At two or more the whole group goes, even from a fight, split evenly among them (you place the odd ones); at one, half goes. Each landing gets at least 1 token.

choices.label: Draw Them Away
choices.description: The card as dealt: 1 token to each of at least two neighbours, the rest stay.

choices.label: Go Loud
choices.description: The new draft (H.0).

variants.label: The Gate
variants.description: The Gate reworked with magnetism, the designer's draft (design document H.0, 2026-11-08; a draft, not a decision), off by default while it is measured. The join stays; each end may be a Sci-Fi location or a location holding the Sci-Fi faction, in any mix (never three factions across them). It places 1 sway at each end (both needed to play it for its action), from the Sci-Fi faction if it is at either end, otherwise a faction there. Then each end pulls in 1 token from its own neighbours for each sway on it (every player's), as many as can come: free, at most half of a group from a fight, never a third faction across the ends.

choices.label: Join
choices.description: The card as dealt: the join, 1 sway at one end.

choices.label: Join and pull
choices.description: The reworked draft (H.0).

variants.label: Spill Blood on the Altar
variants.description: Spill Blood with a bigger stake, the designer's draft (design document H.0, 2026-11-08; a draft, not a decision), off by default while it is measured: spend up to the card's sway on marks, 2 or 3 on each (from one faction there; marks may differ), each mark either reading's, in any mix. Everything else as dealt.

choices.label: 1 per mark
choices.description: The card as dealt.

choices.label: 2 or more per mark
choices.description: The buffed draft (H.0).

variants.label: Unsuited cards' sway
variants.description: D45 (designer, 2026-11-01): an unsuited card may be played for sway with any one faction, chosen as it's played (wild sway): 2 by default; or 1, 3, the cards in hand (as the signatures), or off (no sway use, as before).

variants.label: Card movement range
variants.description: Designer's seed (2026-11-01; testing): cards that move monsters to a neighbour reach any location within this many steps instead (through the Gate as usual). The Big Chase and Bait the Herd's trail still move one location at a time (designer). Sway movement, fights, nightfall and growth keep neighbours. 1 by default (neighbours only); the designer keeps neighbours (2026-11-01, measured: distance doesn't make bigger plays).
